content.description:
Daemon Sprites is comprised of two things. NFTs and AI. A Daemon is a computer program that runs as a background process. A Sprite is a two-dimensional image, most often in a 2D video game.

AI Access. Enjoy access to AI chat with your NFT as your key. Blockchain Only. Conversations are not stored or retained by us. The only data we use and provide will be on the ledger. Global Inclusion. Our NFTs allow you to choose your language. AI and Blockchain capabilities are only just beginning. That is why we believe having a conversation with the future and "past" will help us shape the future.

Cardano is fundamentally built on strong academic peer review, and one of the most decentralized networks. We dug deep into the (e)utxo model and functional programming to provide security and stability as we scale. That is why our first NFT will be the man of the era Voltaire.

Cardano is now developing its governance and having an opportunity to talk to the very person they name their governance era after might help us build a more impactful and fruitful democracy.
